lines.text: She called me out for being late.

data.define: To say publicly that someone did something wrong.

example.text: She called me out for being late.

misuse.text: Don't 'call out' a coworker in front of the boss.

data.l1_hook: Cổ nói hết lỗi của tui cho cả bọn!
data.l1_ex: Cổ called me out vì tui đi trễ.

native.tip: “call out” = Chỉ ra lỗi công khai
native.caption:
“call out” nghĩa là gì?
“call out” = Chỉ ra lỗi công khai.
Ví dụ: “She called me out for being late.” (Cổ called me out vì tui đi trễ.)
